children: may fall toward a range of $89.69 to $90.33 per barrel, driven by a powerful wave c.
A projection analysis reveals this wave's extension below its 176.4% projection level of $92. It is highly likely to travel into the range formed by the 261.8% and the 238.2% levels.
A retracement analysis on the uptrend from $89.16 uncovers a break below the key support at $92.23, the 61.8% level. The break increases the chance of a fall toward $89.16.
Resistance is at $92.40, a break above may lead to a gain into the $93.04-$93.68 range. On the daily chart, the contract failed to break a resistance at $96.57.
The failure, along with the doji during the previous trading session, suggests a completion of the bounce from $89.1, or the first leg of this bounce.
The market may retrace toward the $88.26-$89.91 range.
